sources.title: Pinned Bungie inventory and plug-set definitions
summary: Deafening Whisper is the selected special-ammo Void Wave Frame.
Dimensional Hypotrochoid is the selected heavy-ammo Stasis Compressed Wave Frame.
Both frame descriptions tie wave creation to contact with ground.
sources.boundary: No numerical wave dimensions, speed, slope limit, bounce coefficient, direct-hit damage or full terrain algorithm are exposed by these descriptions.

sources.title: Destiny 2 Update 7.2.0.1 - Season of the Witch
sources.evidenceLocator: Weapons > Weapon Archetypes > Wave Frame Heavy Grenade Launchers; reader lines 397-399
summary: Heavy Wave Frame launchers had both the size and damage of self-damage AOE reduced, to make near-feet firing safer.
sources.boundary: This establishes historical self-damage AOE, not a new radial enemy-damage burst. No radius or damage values are specified; zero self-damage is not established.

sources.title: Destiny 2 Update 7.3.5
sources.evidenceLocator: Weapons > Weapon Archetypes > Heavy Grenade Launcher; reader lines 379-385
summary: Heavy Wave damage increased by 20 percent and wave width by 40 percent.
The enclosing Heavy Grenade Launcher section also reports 10 percent more direct-hit impact damage and 5 percent more detonation damage, with a PvP offset for the latter.
sources.boundary: Historical relative changes, not absolute values. The generic heavy changes do not expose the compressed-wave impact/explosion/wave damage split. Do not apply these multipliers again to an already-current tuning profile. The 40 percent width change is not a heavy-versus-special width ratio.

sources.title: Destiny 2 Update 8.0.0.1
sources.evidenceLocator: Weapons > Wave Grenade Launchers; reader lines 650-654
summary: Blast Radius now changes wave dimensions, predominantly width, with length and height also scaling.
The displayed baseline Blast Radius changed from 100 to 50; 50 denotes the previous baseline and larger stat values enlarge a wave segment.
Special-ammo wave length changed from 22 meters to 15 meters, excluding Dead Messenger.
sources.boundary: The special-ammo length statement covers Deafening Whisper by class, not Dimensional Hypotrochoid. It is a published 2024 value, not a new 2026 measurement. The broader wave-size paragraph is not limited to special ammo, but provides no compressed-wave size curve or absolute heavy length/width. No interpolation law is published.

sources.title: Destiny 2 Update 9.0.0.1
sources.evidenceLocator: Weapons > Wave Frame Weapons; reader lines 936-937
summary: Fixed a bug in which one player’s wave damage temporarily prevented a target from receiving similar-archetype wave damage from other players.
sources.boundary: Supports avoiding a shared cross-player immunity gate; it does not specify same-wave hit count, repeat-hit intervals or a per-projectile collision algorithm.

sources.title: Destiny 2 Update 9.7.0
sources.evidenceLocator: Weapons > Anti-Champion 2.0, reader lines 804-822; Heavy Grenade Launchers > General, lines 987-990
summary: The archetype table assigns Unstoppable to Wave breach GLs and Compressed Wave drum GLs.
Heavy Grenade Launchers receive 5 percent more damage against bosses and champions.
sources.boundary: Later official context, not geometry evidence. Champion behavior is outside this sidecar’s implementation scope; the general heavy change supplies no absolute damage or direct-hit/wave split.
